thread_title: S. psittacina var. okefenokeensis RED GIANT Okaloosa Co, FL
breadcrumb: S. psittacina var. okefenokeensis RED GIANT Okaloosa Co, FL

posts.body_html:
Here's a standout clone that sizes up year after year! How do you know this is a giant and not just some regular form? Well, I guess you compare it to the others from the same population, which are growing under identical conditions and are identical in age, a few sized up while the rest stayed regular sized!


Here's when I first realized this clone was special, these pics are from 2022:


solid red heads!



And check out this baby now, it's in blasting full sun with ZERO shade, from sun up till sunset! pics taken 9/4/24:
